alex: Today: run 1h perf pass, iterate on KV hint TTL, and finish PR review for #4123.

```
./bench --model=rwkv-small --seq=64 --qps=100 --duration=300

```

RESULTS: p50=8ms p95=29ms p99=72ms tokens/s=12.8k evict-rate=0.03
